why.quote: Of these 8 Upper Division courses, students must complete at least 5 Upper Division ENVECON courses.
why.reasoning: Turns the free-text placeholder into a real rule. The same placeholder text says 'These 5 Upper Division ENVECON courses may be satisfied with both Core Requirement courses and Elective Requirement courses. Courses that are cross-listed with ENVECON will also count', so the rule is shared (it re-counts courses that the core and elective rules use) and each group lists the ENVECON course with its cross-listed equivalents. The cross-listings come from the catalog API's equivalentCourseGroup field, or from matching C-numbers with identical titles when that field is empty (ENVECON C118/IAS C118, C132/ECON C184, C176/ENERES C176/IAS C176, C180/ENERES C180, C183/ESPM C183, C188/ECON C188). Only ENVECON courses that appear in this program's core or elective lists are included, because the rule counts 'these 8 Upper Division courses'. All of them are 3 or 4 units, which matches the page's 'Only courses taken for 3 or more units will satisfy this requirement.' The '8 Upper Division courses (3 Core courses + 5 Elective courses)' total is already enforced by the three core rules plus the 5-course elective rule, since each course counts only once.

why.quote: For a complete list of pre-approved elective courses for the EEP major please review on this page.
why.reasoning: The catalog rule lists only 29 courses, but its own description points to the department's pre-approved elective spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a6ca5UQaPWKflENURPZZIkvadO1aLxmAf9bMwda55kc/edit?gid=0#gid=0), which lists about 250 upper-division courses across ENVECON, ECON, ESPM, ENERES, UGBA, CYPLAN, SOCIOL and others. The list is now that spreadsheet plus the catalog's two extra entries (ECON C184 and ECON C188, which are cross-listed with the listed ENVECON C132 and C188). Cross-listed ENVECON courses are grouped with their equivalents. Five subject codes were renamed to their current catalog subject (HIST -> HISTORY; NUSCTX 103/160/166/170 -> NUTRSCI, the only subject with those numbers). Two rows were dropped because the catalog has no such course (NUSCTX 105, NUSCTX 108A), and one row whose Course cell reads 'Spring 2027' (title WATER & DEVELOPMENT) can't be identified. Three courses the sheet approves only conditionally are left out (see the log): ECON 155 ('Students can only count this course as an upper-div elective if they completed ENVECON C102 (instead of C101)'), ESPM 102C ('Approved for CRS double majors only due to enrollment restrictions') and ESPM 120 ('Approved for ES double majors only due to enrollment restrictions'). The sheet's note that 'ECON C125/ENVECON C101 cannot be counted as a core req and an elective' is already GradTrak's default: each course counts once.
